# LGD downturn

The downturn LGD reflects the losses observed when recoveries are lowest.

:::qa {#c-91be0q}
Why must the LGD used for capital reflect a downturn?
---
Capital must cover the losses of a downturn, when recoveries are lowest.
:::

:::cloze {#c-7k2m9x}
$\mathrm{EL} = \mathrm{PD} \times {{c1::\mathrm{LGD}}} \times \mathrm{EAD}$
:::
